content.overview: Section 194, which prohibited forward dealings in the company's securities by a director or key managerial personnel, has been omitted. Forward dealings by directors are not governed by omitted section 194. Insider and trading controls are under the SEBI Act and the PIT Regulations.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: It was omitted by the Companies (Amendment) Act, 2017 with effect from 9 February 2018. It is not a current Companies Act offence. Trading restrictions for listed-company insiders are under the SEBI Act and the PIT Regulations.
